IsAllowed.issue: Closed 2026-07-27: pool eligibility is modelled now. `Relic.is_allowed(run)` exists on the sim's base (sts2_rl/relics/base.py:198, default True) and this relic overrides it with `is_before_act3_treasure_chest(run)` (sts2_rl/relics/bowler_hat.py:22), the `TotalFloor < 41` predicate of RelicModel.IsBeforeAct3TreasureChest (RelicModel.cs:452-456). RunState._drop_disallowed_from_grab_bag (sts2_rl/run.py:769) applies it before EVERY pull and REMOVES the rejects from the bag -- pull_relic_from_front (run.py:731), pull_relic_from_back (run.py:752) and the Shop-rarity bag (run.py:783) are the only three pull paths -- mirroring RelicGrabBag.RemoveDisallowedRelicsFromDeques (RelicGrabBag.cs:218-270), and `Relic.is_allowed_at_neow` now DELEGATES to is_allowed (sts2_rl/relics/base.py:211-222 = RelicModel.cs:443-446) so the Neow pools (sts2_rl/events/neow.py:72) cannot read a stale flag. Verified by execution against today's code: every one of the 17 cluster members returns is_allowed False at total_floor 60 and True at floor 0. WAS: the sim's Relic base declared no is_allowed member at all and populate_relic_grab_bags shuffled the pool once at run init with no per-pull filter, so the relic stayed pullable for the whole run and a late pull also shifted every subsequent pull.

ModifyGoldGained.issue: Closed 2026-07-27: the relic is implemented. sts2_rl/relics/bowler_hat.py's `modify_gold_gained` returns `amount * 1.25` (BowlerHat.cs:18-25's DynamicVar 'GoldIncrease'), and RunState.gain_gold folds the chain over every relic and truncates the product with `int(amount)` (sts2_rl/run.py:384-392), like PlayerCmd.GainGold. WAS: a behaviourless stub whose docstring claimed the sim has no gold system.

AfterModifyingGoldGained.rationale: RelicModel.Flash() / base.Status / ShowCounter / DisplayAmount / CanonicalVars / ExtraHoverTips / Cmd.Wait / CardCmd.Preview are presentation only -- the relic bar's glow, counter and hover text, and animation timing. The sim has no relic UI. Waived under the shared contract's presentation/animation exclusion, not under an unreachability claim.
